title: Antarctica's 1.3 Million Missing Ice Gap Beat Two States
hook: Antarctica's missing ice gap exceeded Texas and California combined.
closing: Less reflective ice leaves more heat in the ocean, affecting everyone beyond Antarctica.
question: Does this record change your climate view?

segments.say: Antarctic sea ice fell to 1.79 million square kilometers, breaking below its long-term range.
Missing sea ice covered 1.3 million square kilometers, exceeding Texas and California combined.
Sea ice reflects 60 percent of sunlight, so losing it lets the darker ocean absorb more heat.
